hero.title: Amazon PPC conversion cost calculator
hero.subtitle: Break down advertising spend into cost per session, cost per conversion, and net profit per unit.

intro: Enter figures from your Amazon PPC reports and unit economics. The calculator stays on this page — results update when you calculate.

tips.title: High cost per conversion
tips.body: Tighten targeting, improve listing relevance, or lower bids before raising budget.

tips.title: Low conversion rate
tips.body: Strengthen images, title, and offer clarity so more clicks become orders.

tips.title: Thin net profit
tips.body: Revisit price, fees, and cost of goods before scaling Sponsored Ads spend.
